svg.aria-label: Openmon animation: an egg hatches in the corner of the screen; the creature reads, hammers and tests along with your AI agent; when the agent needs permission it jumps with a sign and you answer with one click; it is also your assistant: you ask for a reminder in a small box next to it, and on time it tells you; it evolves with the work and becomes a collection of 39 forms, with shiny ones and legendaries. Your agent works. Your Openmon grows and helps you.
